source: Chapter 682 Cull
target: Capitulum 682 Cull

source: Chapter 682 Cull
target: Capitulum 682 Cull

source: Unable to control the dream anymore, Amandina opened her eyes and woke up.
target: Iam somnium regere non poterat, Amandina oculos aperuit et evigilavit.

source: Beside her, Padre Cali snapped out of his slumber, his human form once again becoming hazy and indistinct.
target: Iuxta eam, Padre Cali e somno evigilavit, forma humana eius iterum obscura et incerta facta est.

source: Instinctively, he transformed into a Wraith, as if losing all restraint.
target: Instinctu se in umbram transformavit, quasi omnem moderamen amisisset.

source: Stiff black hair even sprouted from his body.
target: Crines nigri et rigidi etiam ex corpore eius oriri coeperunt.

source: Reflected in Padre Cali’s eyes was Lumian’s figure—Louis Berry, with his black hair, green eyes, and golden straw hat, holding a revolver aimed directly at the Wraith’s forehead.
target: In oculis Padri Cali relucebat figura Lumiani—Louis Berry, capillis nigris, oculis viridibus, et pileo stramineo aureo indutus, revolverum tenens, qui directe in frontem umbrae intendebat.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: Lumian smiled and pulled the trigger, a golden Purifying Bullet exploding from the muzzle and instantly heading straight for the pallor in the Wraith’s forehead.
target: Lumian subridens et manubrium armamenti premens, globulus aureus purgatorius e canna erumpit, qui statim versus pallorem in fronte umbrae properavit.

source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: Cull!
target: Cull!

source: Simultaneously, Lumian waved his empty left hand at Padre Cali, as if to say, “Bye, you won’t be missed!”
target: Simul, Lumian manum sinistram inanitam ad Padre Cali movit, quasi diceret: “Vale, non te desiderabimus!”

source: The Purifying Bullet exploded, and golden flames instantly ignited the ethereal Padre Cali’s entire body.
target: Globulus purgatorius aureus erupit, et flammae aureae totum corpus aetherium Patris Cali statim incendere coeperunt.

source: Padre Cali couldn’t even scream, his agonized thoughts manifesting as an invisible gale sweeping outwards.
target: Padre Cali neclamare quidem potuit, cum cogitationes eius dolentes instar aurae invisibilis se efferebant.

source: Lumian endured the backlash, watching with a grim smile as the enemy was consumed by the purifying flames, reduced to scattered ashes.
target: Lumian toleravit contritionem, spectans vultu tristi, dum hostis flammis purgatoriis consumebatur et in cineres dispersos redactus est.

source: Lumian felt his Reaper potion digest a little more.
target: Lumian sensit potionem Reaper suam paulo magis digeri.

source: Using Cull to reap a powerful foe’s life was a core principle for Reapers—the higher their Sequence and strength, the more potent the acting effect.
target: Uti Cull ad vitam hostis potenti evellendam praeceptum principale Reaperorum erat—quo altior eorum ordo et vis, eo potentior effectus fungebatur.

source: With the addition of Cull, the relatively ordinary and common Purifying Bullet ended the life of a Wraith with just two strikes.
target: Cum adiuncta esset Cull, globulus purgatorius, qui relativus et communis erat, vitam umbrae in duobus ictibus finivit.

source: Lumian found it inexplicably amusing to witness the true incineration of the Padre Cali.
target: Lumian id inexplicabiliter iocundum invenit, veram incinerationem Patris Cali spectans.

source: Why do I always encounter fallen Eternal Blazing Sun padres and cleanse and purify them?
target: Cur semper occursum habeo Padres Solis Aeterni Flagrantis lapsos, eosque purgo atque emundo?

source: Is this repayment for my past faith?
target: Numquid hoc est retributio fidei meae praeteritae?

source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian glanced at the risen Amandina and asked with a smile, “What did he say?”
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius volitabant, Lumian in Amandinam resurrexisse respexit et subridente quaesivit: “Quid dixit?”

source: Amandina’s first reaction was to check the wound on her shoulder. She exclaimed, “It’s completely healed, not a trace left?”
target: Prima responsio Amandinae fuit vulneris in humero suo explorare; exclamavit: “Plane sanatum est, nullum vestigium reliquum?”

source: If it weren’t for her torn clothes and sore shoulder, she would have imagined herself to be uninjured.
target: Nisi vestimenta eius lacerata et humerus dolens essent, putasset se non vulneratam esse.

source: Miss Amandina, don’t act as if you’ve never seen the world. Although you’re a believer in the Eternal Blazing Sun and won’t seek treatment from the clergyman of the Church of Earth Mother unless you are particularly ill, there are many Feynapotterians in Matani. Haven’t you come into close contact with them?
target: Domina Amandina, noli te gerere quasi numquam mundum videris. Quamquam es fidelis Solis Aeterni Flagrantis et medicinam a clerico Ecclesiae Matris Terrae non quaeres nisi valde aegra sis, multi sunt Feynapotteriani in Matani. Num illos prope contiguisti?

source: Lumian criticized her and looked at Amandina coldly without responding.
target: Lumian eam reprehendit et Amandinam frigide respexit, nec respondit.

source: Lugano, on the other hand, saw the beautiful girl’s reaction and explained smugly,
target: Lugano, autem, reactivationem puellae pulchrae vidit et superbum exposuit:

source: “That’s the power of a Doctor from the Planter pathway.”
target: “Haec est potentia Medici ex via Plantatoris.”

source: Amandina expressed her gratitude, then recounted her conversation with Padre Cali while massaging her shoulder to relieve the lingering sourness.
target: Amandina gratiam egit, deinde colloquium cum Padre Cali recitavit, dum humerum suum massabat ad dolorem manentem levandum.

source: At the end, she spat at the spot where his ashes had fallen.
target: Ad finem, in loco ubi cineres eius caderant, sputavit.

source: “He became the Demon’s mouthpiece, using its power to violate Robert and the others.
target: “Luckily, he preferred men. Otherwise…”

source: Recalling how she had frequented Saint-Sien Cathedral over the years and had been a girl with limited knowledge, far from adulthood, Amandina shuddered inwardly. She sympathized with Robert and the others, but she also felt fortunate.
target: Meminens quomodo Cathedralem Sancti-Sien per annos frequentaverit et puella cum parva eruditione, longe ab adultā aetāte fuisset, Amandina intus fremuit. Illa Roberto et ceteris commiseravit, sed etiam se faustam sensit.

source: Lumian had another question in mind.
target: Lumian aliam quaestionem in mente habebat.

source: Could Hisoka’s Wraith abilities also originate from the Dream Festival and the strange black tomb, rather than a direct boon from the Mother Tree of Desire?
target: Possuntne etiam facultates umbrae Hisoka e Festo Somniorum et sepulchro nigro insolito nascī, potius quam ex dono directo a Matre Arboris Desiderii?

source: That would explain a few things better.
target: Id plura melius explicaret.

source: As far as Lumian knew, when evil god believers prayed for boons, they needed to perform a ritual and offer sacrifices. The higher the level of the boon they prayed for, the higher the requirement for the sacrifice, and the larger the ritual.
target: Quantum ad Lumian notum erat, cum credentes dei mali dona precabant, oportebat ritum celebrari atque sacrificia offerre. Quo altior donum precabantur, eo altior erant requisita sacrificii et rituum magnitudo.

source: As a member of Port Pylos’s patrol team, Hisoka could cover up one or two sacrifices, but it was difficult to suppress all the sacrificial incidents. It was just like how Hisoka had only completed one serial murder case in Port Pylos.
target: Ut membrum turmae vigiliarum Portus Pylos, Hisoka unum aut duo sacrificia operire poterat, sed omnes casus sacrificii opprimere difficile erat. Erat enim sicut Hisoka solum unum casum caedis seriatim in Portu Pylos perfecerat.

source: Previously, Lumian had believed that he had relied on Mad Lady’s help to complete the sacrificial rituals in the Southern Continent’s even more chaotic places. But now, it seemed that there was no need for such trouble. He just needed to touch the cold corpse once a year during the Dream Festival.
target: Prius, Lumian credidit se auxilio Mad Lady ad ritus sacrificatorios in locis Continenti Meridionali, quae adhuc magis tumultuosa erant, perficiendos innixum esse. Sed nunc videbatur talis labor non esse necessarius: solum annuum opus habebat ut corpus frigidum tetigeret, in Festo Somniorum.

source: Hisoka and Padre Cali have participated in at least five Dream Festivals and have become Wraiths for some time, but they haven’t made a breakthrough since then… Is this because the cold corpse can only bestow a boon up to Sequence 5? Did Hisoka obtain the large amount of gold and something from the Nois family’s Demon to wait for this year’s Dream Festival to complete the corresponding matters and obtain a higher boon?
target: Hisoka et Padre Cali saltem quinque Festos Somniorum participaverunt et aliquantulum in umbras conversi sunt, sed postea nullum progressum attigerunt… Num quia corpus frigidum solum donum usque ad Ordinem V praebet? Num Hisoka magnam copiam auri ac aliquid ex Daemone familiae Nois obtinuit, ut Festo Somniorum huius anni res pertinentes peragenda et donum maius assequatur?

source: Lumian turned to Robert, who had been dragged nearby, and asked for confirmation, “He’s a Spirit Medium?”
target: Lumian ad Robertum, qui prope tractus erat, se vertit et rogavit: “Estne ille medium spirituum?”

source: “Yes,” Amandina replied. “Padre Cali said Robert gained powers by touching that black boulder too. But why am I a Nightmare while he’s a Spirit Medium?”
target: “Ita,” respondit Amandina. “Padre Cali dixit Robertum vires adeptum esse etiam eo quod illam saxum nigrum tetigerit. Sed cur ego ‘Nightmare’ sum, cum ille ‘Spirit Medium’ sit?”

source: Higher-level, composite power… Just as the Great Mother can bestow three different powers, Apothecary, Planter, and Villain, respectively… Lumian wasn’t surprised by this situation at all. Camus and Rhea were as puzzled as Amandina.
target: Potentia composita altiori… Sicut Magna Mater tribuere potest tres diversas potentias—Apothecary, Planter, et Villain—respective… Lumian haec nullo modo miratus est. Camus et Rhea, sicut Amandina, perplexi erant.

source: Lumian couldn’t be bothered to explain this complicated and high-level problem. He turned around and said to Rhea,
target: Lumian non curabat hanc quaestionem implicatam et altioris gradus explanare. Se convertit et Rhea dixit:

source: “Your dream projection should still exist. Be careful from now on. The question now is whether the death of your dream projection will affect your life.”
target: “Proiectio somniorum tua adhuc exsistere debet. Cave ex hoc tempore. Quaestio nunc est, utrum mors proiectionis somniorum tuae vitam tuam afficiet.”

source: Rhea nodded thoughtfully.
target: Rhea cogitabunda annuit.

source: Lumian shifted his gaze back to Robert, recalling the Demon that had assisted Padre Cali.
target: Lumian iterum in Robertum aspexit, daemonem qui Padre Cali adfuerat recolens.

source: That should be the Nois family member who established a connection with Hisoka…
target: Id debet esse membrum familiae Nois, qui cum Hisoka coniunctionem instituit…

source: Demons don’t do ‘good deeds’ for no reason. Whether it’s establishing a connection with Hisoka or responding to the Padre Cali’s ritual, it must have its own motives. Although witnessing a padre of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church gradually degenerate should be commendable and interesting for a Demon, this isn’t a sufficient reason for its close involvement…
target: Daemonia non faciunt ‘bona opera’ sine causa. Sive coniunctionem cum Hisoka instituere sive ritui Patris Cali respondere, oportet habere proprias causas. Quamquam videndum est patrem Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Flagrantis paulatim degenerare, quod pro Daemone laudabile et iucundum videatur, hoc tamen non sufficit ad eius proximam implicationem…

source: What does it want during the Dream Festival?
target: Quid vult in Festo Somniorum?

source: The cold corpse in the black ancient tomb can bestow a Prisoner pathway boon, and Prisoners are adjacent to the Criminal pathway which Demons are part of…
target: Corpus frigidum in sepulchro antiquo nigro donum viae Carcerarii praebere potest, et Carcerarii adjacent viae Criminalis, cui Daemones participant…

source: Lumian roughly grasped the situation and muttered to himself, “The crucial question now is, where do the gravekeepers go during the Dream Festival? Why aren’t they protecting the black ancient tomb anymore?”
target: Lumian rem vix intellexit, et submurmuravit sibi: “Quaestio nunc maximi momenti est: quo vadunt sepulturarii in Festo Somniorum? Cur sepulchrum antiquum nigrum iam non tuentur?”

source: No one could answer him.
target: Nemo illi respondere potuit.

source: Seeing him staring at the unconscious Robert, Amandina hesitated before saying,
target: Videns eum in Robertum in statu inconscio intuentem, Amandina hesitavit antequam dixit:

source: “Can you let him go? He’s a victim too, don’t kill him.”
target: “Potesne eum dimittere? Ipse quoque victima est, noli eum occidere.”

source: Am I a homicidal maniac in your eyes? Lumian replied with amusement, “As long as Robert doesn’t seek revenge and try to kill me to avenge Padre Cali, I won’t waste my spirituality on him.”
target: Num in oculis tuis homicida insanus sim? Lumian hilariter respondit: “Dummodo Robertus ultam non quaerat et me interficere conetur ut Padre Cali vindicet, spiritualitatem meam in eum non consumam.”

source: Phew… Amandina sighed in relief, then muttered while rubbing her shoulder,
target: Phew… Amandina leviter suspiravit, deinde submurmuravit dum humerum suum terens:

source: “You’re so cold-blooded. I thought you’d kill me to deal with the padre. That shot hurt, you know!”
target: “Es tam frigide sanguine. Putabam te me interficere voluisse ut de Patre ageres. Illud ictus dolet, scis!”

source: Lumian scoffed.
target: Lumian irridens.

source: Between being possessed by a Wraith until you die and getting shot, which would you have preferred?
target: Inter possessionem ab umbra usque ad mortem et ictum percussum, quod mavis?

source: “I don’t care what you think or the sacrifices—I made the right choice to save you, didn’t I?”
target: Non curo quid sentias aut sacrificia—rectam electionem feci ut te servarem, nonne?

source: Amandina, who was just grumbling out of habit, asked with interest upon hearing Lumian’s response, “So you’re willing to make big sacrifices and make correct choices to help important people?”
target: Amandina, quae solum ex consuetudine murmurebat, cum responsum Lumiani audiret, cum studio rogavit: “Itaque magnis sacrificiis ac rectis electionibus magni momenti auxilium ferre paratus es?”

source: “If, and I mean if, my desires were inflamed by a Demon and I’d become a monster without venting them, would you sacrifice yourself to help me?”
target: Si, et id vere dico, desideria mea a Daemone inflammata essent et monstrum fierem sine ea exprimendis, sacrificabisne te ut mihi auxilies?

source: Lumian chuckled and said, “Don’t have such unrealistic expectations of me. But don’t worry, I’ll find someone else willing to make that sacrifice for you.”
target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Noli tales exspectationes irreales de me habere. Sed noli solliciti esse: alium inveniam qui talem sacrificium pro te ferre paratus sit.”

source: His gaze swept over Camus, Lugano, and the unconscious Robert.
target: Conspectus eius per Camus, Lugano, et Robertum inanimatum percurrit.

source: Amandina just muttered, “How lame…”
target: Amandina submurmuravit: “Quam ineptum…”

source: Camus inwardly sighed, feeling he’d escaped the beautiful dream world.
target: Camus intus suspiravit, sentiens se pulcherrimum mundum somniorum effugisse.

source: Lumian looked at Robert again and said to Amandina, “Wake him up and talk to him. I need a favor from him.”
target: Lumian iterum in Robertum intuebatur et Amandinae dixit: “Expergisce eum et cum eo loquere; mihi ab eo auxilium opus est.”

source: If Robert refused, Camus, the interrogation specialist, was there to persuade him.
target: Si Robert recusaverit, Camus, peritus interrogationis, praesto erat ad eum persuadendum.

source: “Alright,” Amandina replied crisply, jolting Robert awake and informing her fiancé of their current predicament.
target: “Recte,” respondit Amandina firmiter, Robertum excitans et sponsum suum de eorum praesenti casu certiorem faciens.

source: She consciously omitted mentioning Padre Cali’s death to maintain the illusion that the Wraith had fled.
target: Ea conscie omisit memorare mortem Patris Cali, ut illusionem retineret Wraith effugisse.

source: “Will you help if I let you go?” Robert asked warily as he struggled to his feet.
target: “Auxilium feres, si te dimitto?” inquit Robert caute, dum ad pedes se conaretur.

source: Lumian gestured to Camus and Rhea. “You may not trust me, but do you trust the patrol team?”
target: Lumian ad Camus et Rhea gestim faciens dixit: “Forsitan in me non confidiatis, sed in turmam vigiliarum creditis?”

source: Robert fell silent for a moment before saying, “What’s the favor?”
target: Robert momento silentium tenuit, deinde dicens: “Quid est favor?”

source: Lumian chuckled. “Go to Twanaku’s house and do something for me.”
target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Vade ad domum Twanaku et aliquid pro me fac.”

source: Brieu Motel, second floor.
target: Brieu Motel, tabulatum secundum.

source: The man in the dark gray suit and the woman in the feathered hat heard soft chewing sounds coming from the corridor—a stark contrast to the shouts, cries, and moans echoing through the motel, as if it shouldn’t be happening during the Dream Festival.
target: Vir in habitu griseo obscuro et femina in pileo plumato audiverunt sonos masticandi lenes ex corridorio venire, in contrarium clamorum, gemitus, et lamentorum per motel resonantium, quasi non debere fieri in Festo Somniorum.

source: Suddenly, the chewing stopped.
target: Subito masticatio cessavit.

source: Almost instantly, the man in the gray suit jumped up as if stabbed in the waist by a red-hot iron rod.
target: Paene statim, vir in habitu griseo surrexit, quasi in lumbos ferro rubro calido percutus.

source: His face tense with sweat beading on his brow, he sprinted to the first floor, traversing the entire staircase in the blink of an eye.
target: Vultus eius, tensus et sudore in fronte stillante, celeriter ad primum tabulatum cucurrit, totam scalas in momento transiens.

source: He ran all the way out of the Brieu Motel to the intersection before stopping, his expression twisted with fear and lingering dread.
target: Currens ex Brieu Motel usque ad crucem viarum pervenit, deinde cessavit, vultu metu et trepidatione permixtus.

source: “What’s wrong?” the woman in the light-colored dress asked, suddenly appearing beside him with confusion and seriousness.
target: “Quid accidit?” inquit femina in vestitu claro, subito iuxta eum apparens, cum confusione et gravitate.

source: The man in the dark gray suit panted heavily.
target: Vir in habitu griseo obscuro graviter anhelabat.

source: “Phew, phew, phew, didn’t you feel it? That terrifying malice!
target: “Phew, phew, phew, nonne sensisti? Illam terribilium malitiam!

source: “The feeling of my heart being ripped out, my tongue torn away, my brain churned into thick soup…”
target: Sensus cordis mei evellendi, linguae meae laceratae, cerebri mei in crassam pultem triturati…”
